llm.summary: This is a coherent self-hosted speech service skill; its sensitive audio and voice-cloning behavior is disclosed and aligned with its purpose.

dimensions.detail: The ASR, TTS, voice cloning, URL fetching, file staging, and MCP capabilities all fit the stated purpose of operating an OpenAI-compatible self-hosted speech service.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The instructions are usage and setup documentation for the service and do not include hidden agent directives, deceptive behavior, or unrelated authority.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Setup relies on Docker images, host volume mounts, port exposure, and model downloads; these are disclosed and normal for this kind of self-hosted ML service.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The service can handle privacy-sensitive audio, transcripts, fetched URLs, staged files, and custom voice samples, but the documented controls include bearer auth, TLS/reverse-proxy guidance, upload/download caps, path checks, logging limits, and an optional private-network download block.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to the configured Docker data volume for models, staged files, URL cache, and custom voices; model residency and cleanup endpoints are documented, and no hidden persistence was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only on a machine and network you trust. Set TALKIES_AUTH_TOKEN, bind to localhost or use a TLS reverse proxy for any external access, enable TALKIES_BLOCK_PRIVATE_DOWNLOADS if untrusted users can submit URLs, and avoid uploading confidential audio or voice samples unless you control the deployment and have permission to use the speaker's voice.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The privacy-sensitive audio and custom-voice flows are central to the skill's purpose and are substantially disclosed, including where files are stored, how URL caching works, auth options, public-exposure guidance, and logging behavior. The concern is best handled as user guidance rather than a Review verdict.
